title: Book One · Chapter 25: The Empty Bag
story:
On Monday, Jun waits by the classroom door.

"Is it in there?" he asks, looking at Ronan's bag.

Ronan holds the handles tighter. "I brought some parts. I did not bring a whole kite."

Jun follows him to the desk. Leo is already there. He moves his book away. Now the middle of the desk is clear.

Ronan takes out the strips. He puts the paper scraps beside them. The list stays in his bag.

Jun looks at the things for a long time.

"Where's my kite?"

"It isn't finished."

"That isn't a kite at all."

"No."

Jun's voice gets louder. "You said it would be ready."

Other children look round. "Did you sell broken wood?" a boy asks. Jun says there was money. The girl from the other class appears at the door with her older sister.

"Mine, too?" she asks.

Ronan nods. His neck feels hot. He wants to put the strips back. He wants to go home with the bag.

Miss Wu comes from the cupboard. She puts down a pile of exercise books.

"One voice," she says. "Jun, tell me first."

Jun tells her about the promised kite and the coin. Miss Wu spoke to the parents earlier. She knows their plan. The class does not know. She explains it to them. "You can all come to the display," she says. "You can look at the work for free." Jun gave a coin for paper and paste. Ronan's mother is keeping that coin.

"Did you give the coin back?" she asks Ronan.

"Not yet."

"Will your mum speak with Jun's mother?"

"Yes."

The girl says her little sister has chosen a red ribbon. Her voice isn't loud. That makes it worse for Ronan.

Miss Wu asks the visiting children to go back to their own rooms. She will help them find a time to talk after school. Then she turns to Ronan.

"Tell them about your work. Are the kites ready? Tell them the truth. Not during this lesson. We all have work now."

She sends him to wash his face. At the tap outside the room, he splashes too much water. The front of his shirt gets wet.

Leo comes with the clean cloth from Ronan's bag.

"I didn't ask you to come," Ronan says.

"I know."

Leo leaves the cloth on the wall. He doesn't stay to watch. Ronan wipes his face and carries it back.

The lesson goes on. The sound of pencils seems very loud. Miss Wu asks a question about numbers. Jun gives the right answer. Ronan is glad Jun knows the answer. But Jun sounds calm now. Ronan is still upset. He looks down at his own book.

At lunch, Leo puts one of the strips across the desk.

"This is for our first kite," he says. "You can still use my string for that."

"Even now?"

"It's still ours. I'm not making the others."

Ronan nods. He takes out the list and puts it beside the strip. He promised three kites. One child gave a coin. None of those kites is finished. The list is clear.

After school, Mum waits near the gate. Miss Wu sent her a short note. Ronan goes to her before Jun can ask again.

"They know," he says.

Mum takes his bag. "Can you show them your paper and sticks?" she asks. "Can you say, 'I cannot finish the kites'?" Ronan looks at the open bag again.

He looks through the gate at Jun standing beside his mother. Then he walks toward them with the empty kite bag open in his hand.
studyGuide:
---

重点表达：empty＝空的；handles＝提手；coin＝硬币；finished＝完成的。

理解问题：

1. Ronan从袋子里拿出了什么？同学们为什么失望？
2. Miss Wu 怎样处理争执，同时保留 Ronan 自己说明的责任？
